finding.title: Null-dropping body members read unresolved in source coverage
finding.body: D-3avp7m and defaults.null_handling: omit make the connector drop an explicit null, written $args.x? (connectors-language.md § @connect body). source-coverage's request classifier does not parse the ? guard: post:/books/search query, genre, maxPriceCents; post:/orders payment.type, payment.last4, payment.brand, payment.iban; patch:/orders/{orderId} note read unresolved. These rows are not verified by the coverage layer; the e2e write-body proof is what proves them.
